summary.en-US: A phone in large type, two colours, that can record a call and write it out

description.en-US:
A call rings on the whole screen with the person's photo and name and two big buttons;
missed calls stay at the top until answered with "call back" or "OK". Contacts read
favourites, then the people called lately, then everyone; a keypad with large keys; the
list of calls. Leave the call for another app and it stays in view: Android's own call
notification with one big "hang up", and a wide green band that brings the call back.

Recording (off by default): a call is recorded and written out on the phone by
whisper.cpp, the model fetched once and shared with the other Reader's apps. Android only
gives the sound of a call to an accessibility service, so one has to be switched on; the
settings say so. Tell the other person — in many countries the law requires it.

Six languages. No account; the network is used only to fetch the model.
